strategy.summary: The static todo app (public/app.js, in-memory state per page load) already supports completing, filtering and clearing todos. The tests must prove through the browser that ticking/unticking a todo toggles its strike-through and the "items left" count, that the All/Active/Completed filters show the right todos and mark the selected filter pressed, and that "Clear completed" shows only while a todo is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Completing and un-completing a todo via its checkbox (strike-through, items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their aria-pressed state
Visibility and effect of the Clear completed button
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; the ticket does not ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (the URL run_tests uses); nothing is faked, there is no backend API or access control.
Todo state lives in page memory, so each test starts from an empty list by loading the page, and tests share no data.
'Struck through' is checked as the todo text's computed text-decoration-line being line-through (styles.css `li.completed span`), a user-visible style rather than the class name.
'Shown as pressed' means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others (index.html / app.js).
openQuestions: The ticket doesn't say whether 'Clear completed' should also remove completed todos hidden by the Active filter; the code removes all completed todos regardless of filter, and the tests exercise it from the All view only.

risks.description: Count text and strike-through drift out of sync with checkbox state after re-render (list is rebuilt on every change)
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2 assert checkbox state, strike-through and count together after each toggle.

risks.description: Filter shows wrong items or pressed state not updated
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert the exact list of visible titles and aria-pressed on all three buttons.

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or stays visible with nothing to clear
risks.mitigation: TC6/TC7 assert hidden/visible transitions and the exact remaining list.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: it is struck through and the 'items left' count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
The Active filter shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
'Clear completed' is shown only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
steps: Assert '2 items left' and 'Buy milk' not struck through
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is checked, its text has text-decoration-line line-through, 'Walk dog' is not struck through, and the count reads '1 item left'.

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is unchecked, its text-decoration-line is none, and the count reads '2 items left'.

testCases.title: Active filter shows only uncompleted todos and is pressed
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
testCases.expected: List items are exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active has aria-pressed true, All and Completed false.

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
testCases.expected: List items are exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed has aria-pressed true, All and Active false.

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again after another filter was selected
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
steps: Click Completed and assert only 'Walk dog' shows
testCases.expected: List items are exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All has aria-pressed true, Active and Completed false.
testCases.rationale: All must restore the full list, not just be the initial state.

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
steps: Add 'Buy milk' and assert '1 item left'
Tick 'Buy milk' and assert Clear completed is visible
testCases.expected: Clear completed is hidden with no completed todos, visible once one is completed, and hidden again after unticking.
testCases.rationale: The refusal side of clearing: the action is not offered when nothing is completed.

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
preconditions: Page loaded with an empty list
testCases.expected: List items are exactly ['Walk dog'], count reads '1 item left', and Clear completed is hidden.
testCases.rationale: Proves 'every' completed todo is removed, not just one, and active ones are kept.

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer in playwright.config.js starts `node server.js` on http://localhost:4173; Chromium must be installed. No env vars or seed data.

review.standard: Assertions prove the behaviour the title names (no assertion that can pass for the wrong reason)
review.summary: The unticking test claims the strike-through is removed but never checks that 'Buy milk' was struck through after ticking, so the final text-decoration-line 'none' check passes even if the strike-through is never applied.
review.failureScenario: If a regression stops the 'completed' class or the line-through style being applied, ticking leaves the text at 'none'. Unticking also leaves it at 'none', so line 47 passes and this test stays green even though there was never a strike-through to remove. After the '1 item left' check on line 42, also assert that titleText(page, 'Buy milk') has text-decoration-line 'line-through' before unchecking.

review.summary: clearCompleted (line 9) and the Add button and 'What needs doing?' label in addTodos (lines 14-15) match on substrings, while the file's other locators use exact: true.
review.failureScenario: If the app later adds a button whose name contains 'Add' (e.g. 'Add tag') or 'Clear completed' (e.g. 'Clear completed and archived'), getByRole without exact matches both. That causes a strict-mode violation or, for the toBeHidden checks, a match on the wrong element. Add { exact: true } to these locators.
